publication.caption:
These three came straight over to inspect the camera while Ms. Piggy stayed close to the rest of the litter behind them. That mix of confidence, curiosity and staying close to mum is one of those ordinary farm moments worth sharing.

Follow the farm journey for more honest moments from behind the scenes at Amadeus Farm.
